cond_0233.intro: The Department of Human Oncology at [Company name masked] has an opening for a CHS track faculty position at the Assistant or Associate Professor level.
cond_0233.responsibilities:
This position will primarily involve delivering radiation oncology clinical services. You will conduct new patient consultations, lead weekly patient management, and direct external beam radiation treatment programs. Thorough training and experience with IMRT/SBRT, Tomotherapy, 4DRT, stereotactic radiosurgery and brachytherapy are strongly desired. You will also take an active role in clinical trials — including participation and development — as a component of the clinical practice.
You will teach medical students, residents, and fellows.
You will take ownership of administrative and committee responsibilities to advance the clinical and scholarly missions of [Company name masked] and the School of Medicine and Public Health. An essential part of these duties will be working in a collegial relationship with other faculty members.

Terminal Degree
M.D. Or M.D./Ph.D
Completion of residency training in Radiation Oncology and Board certification (or expected within 2 years of hiring). Post-residency clinical experience valuable but not mandatory.

For an appointment at Clinical Associate Professor or Clinical Professor rank on CT Track, candidates will meet criteria established by the department and as outlined in the School of Medicine and Public Health guidelines for promotion or appointment to Associate or Professor on the CT Track.

Applicants must be able to obtain licensure in [Location masked] without restriction.

This position will primarily involve provision of radiation oncology clinical services. Activities will include performing new patient consultation, weekly patient management, and supervision of external beam radiation treatment programs. Thorough training and experience with IMRT/SBRT, Tomotherapy, 4DRT, stereotactic radiosurgery, and brachytherapy are strongly desired. Clinical trials experience, participation, and development is strongly encouraged as a component of the clinical practice. A teaching role for residents in training is also anticipated.
The successful candidate will teach medical students, residents, and fellows.
The chosen applicant will contribute to administrative and committee work in support of the clinical and scholarly missions of [Company name masked] and the School of Medicine and Public Health. An essential part of these duties will be working in a collegial relationship with other faculty members.
cond_0403.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.D. Or M.D./Ph.D.
Completion of residency training in Radiation Oncology and Board certification (or expected within 2 years of hiring).
MD - Physician - State Licensure.
Applicants must be able to obtain licensure in [Location masked] without restriction.
Preferred Requirements
Post-residency clinical experience (valuable but not mandatory).
For appointment at Associate Professor or Professor rank on CHS Track, candidates will meet criteria established by the department and as outlined in the School of Medicine and Public Health guidelines for promotion or appointment to Associate or Professor on the CHS Track.
